## Gap analysis

Where mdlc loses (typically to ORT CUDA EP on conv-heavy graphs), the cause is algorithmic, not mysterious: ORT dispatches cuDNN's shape-specialized implicit-GEMM / Winograd conv kernels with tensor-core paths, while mdlc lowers conv via explicit im2col + a tiled fp32 SGEMM with no tensor cores and no double buffering. The wins at batch-1 come from the launch-bound regime: fused kernels cut launch count (per-row launch column) and remove framework dispatch. Closing the conv gap means implicit GEMM (gather patches inside the GEMM K-loop) and a Winograd path for 3×3 s1 — both scoped in docs/STATUS.md as the post-lock stretch.
